title: EUReCA: End-to-End Unified CBCT Reconstruction Across Clinical Acquisitions
abstract: arXiv:2610.37740v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image-guided radiotherapy, but reducing the number of projections to lower dose and scan time makes reconstruction increasingly ill-posed. We present EUReCA (End-to-end Unified REconstruction across Clinical Acquisitions), a geometry-aware feed-forward model for variable-view clinical linac CBCT. For a given acquisition trajectory, EUReCA accepts 8-100 projections with a single set of weights, without view-count-specific retraining; the same architecture and training recipe extend unchanged to other clinical trajectories. It combines learned projection features with an in-frame Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstruction. translated_title: EUReCA：跨临床采集的端到端统一CBCT重建
translated_abstract: 锥束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）广泛应用于图像引导放射治疗，但为了降低辐射剂量和扫描时间而减少投影数量，会使重建问题变得越来越不适定。我们提出了EUReCA（跨临床采集的端到端统一重建），这是一种面向可变视角临床直线加速器CBCT的几何感知前馈模型。对于给定的采集轨迹，EUReCA只需一组权重即可处理8-100个投影，无需针对视角数量进行重新训练；相同的架构和训练方案无需修改即可直接扩展到其他临床采集轨迹。该方法将学习到的投影特征与帧内Feldkamp-Davis-Kress（FDK）重建相结合。该模型使用共享的多尺度骨干网络对每个投影进行编码，利用采集几何将特征反投影到多分辨率3D网格中，以固定的计算成本聚合可变数量的视角，并通过全局3D Transformer细化体数据……
tldr: EUReCA提出了一种几何感知的前馈模型，仅需一组权重即可处理8-100个可变视角投影，实现临床直线加速器CBCT的端到端统一重建，无需针对视角数量重新训练，且架构可直接扩展到其他临床采集轨迹。
en_tdlr: EUReCA is a geometry-aware feed-forward model that achieves end-to-end unified CBCT reconstruction across clinical acquisitions, handling 8-100 variable-view projections with a single set of weights without view-count-specific retraining while extending unchanged to other clinical trajectories.
